## What changed and why?

Describe the user-visible behavior and any command-line compatibility changes.

## Validation

- Run `tools/Test-Repository.ps1` with the pinned test dependencies.
- Add regression coverage for behavioral fixes using mocks or synthetic fixtures.
- For administrative changes, show a `-WhatIf` example and recovery procedure.
- Record any live validation separately; never put credentials or private reports in a PR.
